caps.hint.en: Declare reasoning efforts per catalog model; saving writes the settings document and applies immediately.
caps.hint.zh: 为目录里的每个模型声明推理档位，保存写入设置文档并立即生效。

caps.empty.en: No editable model catalog for this provider yet. Add model rows in the catalog above, then come back here to declare capabilities per model.
caps.empty.zh: 此提供方还没有可编辑的模型目录。先在上方模型目录中添加模型行，再回到这里为每个模型声明能力。

caps.readOnly.en: The settings document is read-only; changes are disabled.
caps.readOnly.zh: 当前设置文档只读，无法修改。

caps.efforts.inheritHint.en: Follows the built-in catalog; a hand-declared model has nothing to follow, which behaves like no reasoning.
caps.efforts.inheritHint.zh: 跟随内置目录的声明；自定义模型没有目录可跟随，等同无推理。

caps.efforts.noneHint.en: Declare this model as non-reasoning (reasoningEfforts: false); the model picker stops offering thinking levels.
caps.efforts.noneHint.zh: 声明该模型不参与推理（reasoningEfforts: false），模型选择器不再提供思考档位。

caps.efforts.levelsHint.en: Check the levels the model supports and fill in the wire value each one sends.
caps.efforts.levelsHint.zh: 勾选模型支持的档位，并填写请求里实际发送的取值。

caps.wire.offHint.en: off may stay empty: "supported, but send nothing when chosen".
caps.wire.offHint.zh: off 可留空：表示「支持，但发送时不带参数」。

caps.preset.common.en: Fill the common low / medium / high
caps.preset.common.zh: 填入常用 low / medium / high

caps.staleDraft.en: The configuration changed in another surface; your unsaved changes are kept and re-checked when you save.
caps.staleDraft.zh: 配置已被其他界面修改；你的未保存修改仍保留，保存时会再次校验。

caps.conflict.en: The configuration changed in another surface; reloaded — please retry.
caps.conflict.zh: 配置已被其他界面修改，已重新读取，请重试。

caps.invalid.wire.en: Level {level} needs a non-empty wire value.
caps.invalid.wire.zh: 档位 {level} 需要非空的发送值。

caps.invalid.offOnly.en: Declare at least one level beyond off, or switch to "No reasoning".
caps.invalid.offOnly.zh: 至少声明一个 off 以外的档位，或改选「无推理」。

caps.disable.hint.en: A disabled provider leaves the composer model picker and the subagent selection immediately; its configuration is archived and can be restored at any time.
caps.disable.hint.zh: 禁用后该提供方立即从输入框模型选择器与子代理可选模型中消失；配置会存档，可随时启用恢复。

caps.state.disabled.en: This provider is disabled: its models are absent from the composer picker and the subagent selection. The configuration is archived; enabling restores it.
caps.state.disabled.zh: 该提供方已禁用：模型不出现在输入框模型选择器与子代理可选列表中。配置已存档，启用即恢复。

caps.footer.hint.en: These providers have archived configurations; enabling restores the original profile and puts it back into the model picker and the subagent selection.
caps.footer.hint.zh: 这些提供方的配置已存档；启用后恢复原配置，并重新出现在模型选择器与子代理可选列表中。

caps.error.routeExists.en: The provider already has a newer configuration; the archive cannot be restored. Remove the current configuration first, then enable.
caps.error.routeExists.zh: 该提供方已存在新配置，无法恢复存档；请先移除现有配置再启用。

caps.error.partialEnable.en: Enabled, but clearing the archive failed: {error}
caps.error.partialEnable.zh: 已启用，但清理存档失败：{error}

caps.error.baseProfile.en: The composition layer also declares this provider, so disabling cannot take it down; the action is not offered.
caps.error.baseProfile.zh: 该提供方在组合层也声明了配置，禁用无法让它下线，因此不提供此操作。

caps.error.unavailable.en: Cannot toggle: the plugin archive settings entry is not served.
caps.error.unavailable.zh: 无法切换：未找到插件的存档设置项。

caps.seat.conflict.en: The Model capabilities panel is not mounted: another plugin ({plugin}) holds the provider-card extension seat, which renders one extension area per provider card. The panel returns as soon as that plugin is unloaded.
caps.seat.conflict.zh: 「模型能力」面板未挂载：模型卡片的扩展插槽已被插件 {plugin} 占用，同一插槽只渲染一个扩展区。该插件卸载后本面板自动恢复。
